requirement:
修复订单数据模型的 bug。
订单实体类的字段定义有误，导致序列化时数据丢失。
需要修正订单模型并检查所有引用订单数据的服务。

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and likely shares or references the order data model, so serialization fixes may need alignment.

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin service for orders that queries and displays order data, so it may be affected by changes to the order model.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve-service but for other order types, it interacts with order data and may need adjustments.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooks orders and depends on order data, so it may need to align with the corrected model.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancels orders and reads/writes order data, so it is likely affected by changes to the order model.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Creates orders during ticket preservation and depends on order data structures, so it may need updates to match the corrected model.

details.name: ts-payment-service
details.rationale: Handles payments for orders and references order data, so it may need to ensure compatibility with the fixed model.

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: Internal payment service that processes order payments and may rely on order fields, so it could be affected.

details.name: ts-execute-service
details.rationale: Executes order-related operations and may consume order data, so it could be impacted by serialization changes.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Sends notifications about order status and may use order data, so it could need updates if the model changes.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Routes requests to order services and may pass order data, but its impact is lower as it is a proxy layer.
